description: An agent-based, network-coupled SEIR and social-influence simulation of mask adoption and disease spread. Agents (people) move across locations, observe peers, respond to policies, face retail supply constraints, and update adoption and mask type. Disease transmission is modified by mask dyadic efficacy and location ventilation. Policies, enforcement, and messaging influence compliance and adoption dynamics.

modules.name: SocialNetwork
modules.description: Build and manage the person-to-person contact network and tie strengths; feeds social influence and information diffusion.

notes: Tie strengths normalized so sum of weights from i to neighbors = 1.
Topology fixed by default; optional slow rewiring can reflect mobility changes.

modules.name: InformationDiffusion
modules.description: Update perceived risk and trust via DeGroot-style averaging and public messaging.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  social_signal = sum_j( tie_strength[i,j] * neighbor_j.mask_status )
  epidemic_signal = normalized_new_infections = min(1, new_infections_daily / population_size * 50)
  messaging_signal = authority_credibility * (messaging_frequency_per_week/7)
  delta_perceived_risk = risk_perception_update_rate * (0.5*epidemic_signal + 0.5*social_signal - perceived_risk_i)
  perceived_risk_i += delta_perceived_risk
  trust_in_authorities_i = clamp( trust_in_authorities_i + 0.1*(messaging_signal - 0.5), 0, 1 )
notes: Perceived risk bounded [0,1].
Social signal is fraction of masked neighbors weighted by tie strengths.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcement
modules.description: Impose mandates, perform enforcement at locations, and update compliance levels.

notes: Policy strength can modulate enforcement_probability externally if needed.
Compliance decays in absence of enforcement.

modules.name: RetailSupply
modules.description: Manage retailer inventory, restocking, pricing, and customer purchases.

notes: No negative inventory; purchase queue must check stock before decrement.
Prices are read-only parameters here; dynamic pricing could be added via adjust_prices.

modules.name: MaskAdoptionDecision
modules.description: Decision-making for adopting and wearing a mask type based on perceived risk, social influence, policy, and prices.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  # compute social norm
  social_mask_rate = sum_j( tie_strength[p,j] * neighbor_j.mask_status )
  # utility for wearing any mask
  U_wear = p.adoption_propensity - (adoption_threshold_mean) + social_influence_weight*social_mask_rate + policy_weight*p.compliance_level + p.perceived_risk
  # cost term: cheapest available option locally/household
  cheapest_price = min(price_cloth, price_surgical, price_n95)
  U_cost = - price_weight * (cheapest_price / max(1, p.ses))
  U_total = U_wear + U_cost
  if sigmoid(U_total) > 0.5:
    p.mask_status = 1
    # choose type prioritizing efficacy/price and household inventory
    if household has any mask:
      choose type m with highest (efficacy/price) ratio available
      decrement household inventory for m
      p.mask_type = m
    else:
      enqueue purchase_queue request for type argmax_m (efficacy/price)
      p.mask_type = requested type (tentative)
  else:
    p.mask_status = 0
    p.mask_type = 'none'
notes: adoption_propensity is person-specific threshold noise drawn at init from N(adoption_threshold_mean, adoption_threshold_std).
SES scales perceived price burden.
If purchase fails due to stockout, person may remain unmasked or use lower-tier mask if available.

modules.name: MobilityAndContacts
modules.description: Generate daily contacts by location type based on participation rates and contact rate parameters.

notes: Home contacts limited to household members.
Participation rates control attendance probability by type.

modules.name: InfectionTransmission
modules.description: Compute infection events from contacts with mask- and ventilation-modified transmission probabilities.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_infections = 0
for each contact (i, j, location ℓ):
  if health_status_i == 'Infectious' and health_status_j == 'Susceptible':
    eff_out = efficacy_out(mask_type_i)
    eff_in = efficacy_in(mask_type_j)
    v = ventilation_effect_ℓ
    p_transmit = base_transmission_rate_beta * (1 - eff_out) * (1 - eff_in) * (1 - v)
    if Bernoulli(p_transmit):
      infect j; new_infections += 1
  (swap roles i<->j)
output new_infections_daily = new_infections
notes: Dyadic efficacy: outward source reduction and inward recipient reduction multiplicatively applied.
Location ventilation reduces risk multiplicatively.

modules.name: HealthProgression
modules.description: Advance disease states (SEIR), including latent and infectious periods and asymptomatic cases.

notes: Initial infections seeded by initial_infected_fraction at t=0.
Asymptomatic_fraction can reduce infectiousness (optional multiplier) or bypass symptoms; here it does not change transmission unless modeled separately.

requirements: list of newly infected agents per day

modules.name: HouseholdDynamics
modules.description: Share information and masks within households and exert intra-household influence.

notes: Household influence nudges adoption propensity towards household norm.
Inventory tracked per household; no negative inventory allowed.

modules.name: AggregationAndMetrics
modules.description: Aggregate observables and compute intermediate indicators such as Rt and steady-state adoption.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(Person.mask_status)
new_cases_t = new_infections_daily
cum_infections += new_cases_t
Rt = new_cases_t / max(1, new_cases_{t-serial_interval_days})
enforcement_today = enforcement_actions_daily
stockout_today = stockout_indicator_daily
# equity gap: Q5 - Q1 adoption
adopt_q1 = mean(mask_status where ses in lowest quintile)
adopt_q5 = mean(mask_status where ses in highest quintile)
equity_gap = adopt_q5 - adopt_q1
# optional counterfactual baseline (no-mask): use precomputed or synchronized control run
cumulative_infections_no_mask = running value from control scenario if available
notes: Rt uses a fixed serial interval; smoothing optional.
Counterfactual cumulative infections require a separate control run without masks; pipeline must provide or compute.

algorithms.SmallWorldNetwork: Watts-Strogatz generator for social ties; supports tie strength assignment via log-normal weights.
algorithms.DeGrootInfluence: Linear averaging of neighbor states with normalized tie weights to update beliefs and norms.
algorithms.UtilityThresholdAdoption: Sigmoid of linear utility combining propensity, social influence, policy compliance, perceived risk, and price burden.
algorithms.PoissonContactGenerator: Sample daily contacts per location via Poisson rates and random pairing.
algorithms.SEIRProgression: Discrete-time latency and infectiousness timers with state transitions E->I->R.
algorithms.OrderUpToRestocking: Periodic restocking with delay; maintain non-negative inventory.
algorithms.RtEstimator: Empirical ratio of new cases at lagged serial interval with stability guards.
algorithms.ConvergenceChecker: Compute rolling change in adoption to assess steady state.
